answer: Under salvo-enrollment, every epoch the knoll network forces each fresh identity to answer a distinct nonce from every other fresh joiner within one second, verified by signed timestamps. A lone honest agent faces exactly one exchange per epoch, paying trivial latency overhead, so the plume of legitimate newcomers grows smoothly. A Sybil farm launching n fakes must sustain n×(n−1) coordinated responses, reaching zenith difficulty at n=100 with 9,900 sub-second replies per epoch; at n=1000 that becomes 999,000, a nonlinear explosion.
